```{r}
library(here)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(spData)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r}
eez <- st_read(here("potential-aquaculture", "data", "wc_regions_clean.shp")) 

depth <- rast(here("potential-aquaculture", "data", "depth.tif"))

sst_files <- list.files(path = "potential-aquaculture/data/sst",
                        pattern = "\\.tif$",
                        full.names = TRUE)

sst <- rast(sst_files)


crs(depth) <- crs(sst) 
```



```{r}
# Verification that crs match
if((st_crs(eez) == st_crs(sst)) & (st_crs(eez) == st_crs(depth))){
  print("coordinate reference systems match!")
}else{
  warning("coordinate reference systems do NOT match")
  print(paste("eez has ", st_crs(eez)$epsg, "EPSG"))
  print(paste("depth has",  st_crs(depth)$epsg, "EPSG"))
  print(paste("sst has",  st_crs(sst)$epsg, "EPSG"))
}
```

# Process data
```{r}
# Find the mean SST from 2008-2012 in Celsius
sst_C <- mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE) - 273.15
```


```{r}
# Crop depth raster to match the extent of the SST raster
depth_cropped <- crop(depth, sst_C)

# Resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach
depth_resampled <- resample(depth_cropped, sst_C, method = "bilinear")

# Check if features match
cat("After resampling:\n")
cat("CRS match:    ", same.crs(sst_C, depth_resampled), "\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(sst_C) == res(depth_resampled)), "\n")
cat("Origins match:    ", all(round(origin(sst_C), 8) == round(origin(depth_resampled), 8)), "\n")
cat("Extents match:    ", ext(sst_C) == ext(depth_resampled), "\n")

```



# Find suitable locations

Oysters
Research has shown that oysters need the following conditions for optimal growth:

sea surface temperature: 11-30°C
depth: 0-70 meters below sea level

species of interest: Kumamoto Oyster


```{r}
sst_min <- 11
sst_max <- 30

depth_min <- -70
depth_max <- 0
 
# SST reclassification matrix
sst_rcl <- matrix(c(
  -Inf,   sst_min,  0,
  sst_min,  sst_max,  1,
  sst_max,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

suitable_sst <- classify(sst_C, rcl = sst_rcl)

# Depth reclassification matrix
depth_rcl <- matrix(c(
  -Inf,   depth_min,  0,
  depth_min,  depth_max,  1,
  depth_max,  Inf,  0
), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

suitable_depth <- classify(depth_resampled, rcl = depth_rcl)


# Find locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions
suitable_combined <- c(suitable_sst, suitable_depth)
suitable <- lapp(suitable_combined, fun = function(temp, depth) temp * depth) 
```




```{r}
# rasterize eex boundaries
eez_raster <- rasterize(eez, suitable, field = "rgn_id")

#
suitable_boundary <- mask(suitable, eez_raster)
suitable_boundary[suitable_boundary == 0] <- NA
plot(suitable_boundary)

```


```{r}
# Calculate suitable area per each cell in km^2
cell_area <- cellSize(suitable_boundary, unit = "km")

# The suitable cells, each cells contains their suitable area in km^2 
suitable_area <- cell_area * suitable_boundary
```

```{r}
# Create a raster that has the same extent, resolution, and CRS as suitable_area
regions <- rasterize(eez, suitable_area, field = "rgn_id")

# Sum of suitable area per region 
suitable_eez <- zonal(suitable_area, regions, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

suitable_area_eez <- suitable_eez|> 
  as.tibble() 

suitable_area_eez|> 
  arrange(desc(area)) |> 
  kable(col.names = c("Region", "Area (km)"), caption = "Suitable Area per Exclusive Economic Zone") |> 
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped")
```


```{r}
# join the suitable area per region data frame with the eez polygons
area_eez <- left_join(suitable_area_eez, eez)
```

```{r}
area_eez_sf <- st_as_sf(area_eez)

tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap") +
tm_shape(area_eez_sf) +

tm_shape(suitable_area) +
  tm_raster(col.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = "red"),
            col.legend = tm_legend_hide()) +
```
